en.summary: Disclosure, focus and reading position; Chromium
details: dir              Published site directory; default: public
--headed         Show the browser window
--trace          Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>      Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>   Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--page <path>    Published article with a document aside
--widths <list>  Comma-separated viewport widths in pixels; default: 390,768,1800
--touch          Use taps and a mobile touch context
swban check/browser/aside/toggle ./preview --page /article/
swban check/browser/aside/toggle ./preview --page /article/ --trace --out ./browser-report

zh.summary: 侧栏开合、焦点与阅读位置；Chromium
details: dir              已完成的站点构建目录；默认：public
--headed         显示浏览器窗口
--trace          保存 trace.zip；默认输出到系统临时目录
--out <dir>      在新子目录保存 JSON 和截图
--timeout <ms>   浏览器启动和单次操作的超时，单位为毫秒；默认：15000
--page <path>    已构建且含文档侧栏的文章
--widths <list>  视口宽度，单位为像素，用逗号分隔；默认：390,768,1800
--touch          使用移动触摸环境和点按
swban check/browser/aside/toggle ./preview --page /article/
swban check/browser/aside/toggle ./preview --page /article/ --trace --out ./browser-report
